import os, json, joblib, warnings, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

SEED = 42
WARD = "work"; os.makedirs(WARD, exist_ok=True)
base = "../input/data"
train = pd.read_csv(f"{base}/train_data/train.csv")
val   = pd.read_csv(f"{base}/validation_data/validation.csv")
test  = pd.read_csv(f"{base}/predict_data/test.csv")

# ---- protocol: fixed validation IDs ----
val_ids_path = f"{WARD}/val_ids.json"
val_ids = val["PassengerId"].tolist()
if os.path.exists(val_ids_path):
    assert json.load(open(val_ids_path)) == val_ids, "val IDs changed"
else:
    json.dump(val_ids, open(val_ids_path, "w"))
assert not set(train["PassengerId"]) & set(val["PassengerId"])
assert not set(train["PassengerId"]) & set(test["PassengerId"])
assert not set(val["PassengerId"]) & set(test["PassengerId"])

def featurize(df):
    d = df.copy()
    d["FamilySize"] = d["SibSp"] + d["Parch"] + 1
    d["IsAlone"] = (d["FamilySize"] == 1).astype(int)
    title = d["Name"].str.extract(r",\s*([^.]+)\.", expand=False)
    title = title.replace({"Mlle": "Miss", "Ms": "Miss", "Mme": "Mrs"})
    d["Title"] = title.fillna("Rare")
    return d

tr_f, val_f, te_f = featurize(train), featurize(val), featurize(test)
# rare titles (count<10 over training rows) -> 'Rare' using fitted mapping
tc = tr_f["Title"].value_counts()
rare = tc[tc < 10].index
for d in (tr_f, val_f, te_f):
    d["Title"] = d["Title"].where(~d["Title"].isin(rare), "Rare")
for d in (tr_f, val_f, te_f):
    d["Embarked"] = d["Embarked"].fillna("M")

num_cols = ["Pclass", "SibSp", "Parch", "FamilySize", "IsAlone"]
af_cols  = ["Age", "Fare"]
cat_cols = ["Sex", "Embarked", "Title"]

def make_pre():
    return ColumnTransformer([
        ("num", Pipeline([("imp", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")), ("sc", StandardScaler())]), num_cols),
        ("af",  Pipeline([("imp", SimpleImputer(strategy="median", add_indicator=True)), ("sc", StandardScaler())]), af_cols),
        ("cat", Pipeline([("imp", SimpleImputer(strategy="constant", fill_value="M")),
                          ("oh", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"))]), cat_cols),
    ])

y = tr_f["Survived"].values
X = tr_f[num_cols + af_cols + cat_cols]

def fit_lr(Xf, yf):
    p = Pipeline([("pre", make_pre()), ("lr", LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, random_state=SEED))]).fit(Xf, yf)
    return p
def fit_et(Xf, yf, depth, leaf):
    p = Pipeline([("pre", make_pre()), ("et", ExtraTreesClassifier(
        n_estimators=400, max_depth=depth, min_samples_leaf=leaf,
        random_state=SEED, n_jobs=4))]).fit(Xf, yf)
    return p

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
folds = list(skf.split(X, y))
print("folds:", [len(v) for _, v in folds])

def sweep(Xf):
    rows = []
    for depth in [5, 6, 7, 8]:
        for leaf in [2, 3, 4, 6]:
            oof_lr = np.zeros(len(y)); oof_et = np.zeros(len(y))
            for tri, vai in folds:
                lr = fit_lr(Xf.iloc[tri], y[tri])
                et = fit_et(Xf.iloc[tri], y[tri], depth, leaf)
                oof_lr[vai] = lr.predict_proba(Xf.iloc[vai])[:, 1]
                oof_et[vai] = et.predict_proba(Xf.iloc[vai])[:, 1]
            for w in [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7]:
                prob = w * oof_lr + (1 - w) * oof_et
                acc = accuracy_score(y, (prob >= 0.5).astype(int))
                rows.append(dict(w=w, depth=depth, leaf=leaf, cv_acc=acc))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

sweep_df = sweep(X)
sweep_df = sweep_df.sort_values("cv_acc", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
sweep_df.to_csv(f"{WARD}/sweep_comparison.csv", index=False)
print("sweep time %.1fs, combos=%d" % (time.time() - t0, len(sweep_df)))
print(sweep_df.head(12).to_string())

# also record incumbent CV for comparison
def cv_one(w, depth, leaf):

best = sweep_df.iloc[0]

# ---- Final model: fit CV-chosen config on all 712 rows ----
bw, bd, bl = float(best.w), int(best.depth), int(best.leaf)
lr_final = fit_lr(X, y)
et_final = fit_et(X, y, bd, bl)

    return w * lr.predict_proba(Xf)[:, 1] + (1 - w) * et.predict_proba(Xf)[:, 1]

Xv = val_f[num_cols + af_cols + cat_cols]
Xt = te_f[num_cols + af_cols + cat_cols]
val_pred = (blend_proba(lr_final, et_final, Xv, bw) >= 0.5).astype(int)
test_pred = (blend_proba(lr_final, et_final, Xt, bw) >= 0.5).astype(int)

pd.DataFrame({"PassengerId": val["PassengerId"], "Survived": val_pred}).to_csv(f"{WARD}/val_predictions.csv", index=False)
pp = pd.DataFrame({"PassengerId": test["PassengerId"], "Survived": test_pred})
pp.to_csv("predictions.csv", index=False)

metrics = {
    "seed": SEED,
    "cv_folds": 5,
    "chosen": {"w": bw, "depth": bd, "leaf": bl, "cv_acc": float(best.cv_acc)},
    "incumbent": {"w": 0.5, "depth": 6, "leaf": 4, "cv_acc": inc_cv, "fixed_val_accuracy": 0.8492},
    "cv_gain": float(best.cv_acc - inc_cv),
    "note": "prob>=0.5 -> 1; fixed-validation accuracy scored by evaluator; both val/test predictions from the same final model",
}
json.dump(metrics, open(f"{WARD}/metrics.json", "w"), indent=2)
joblib.dump({"lr": lr_final, "et": et_final, "w": bw}, f"{WARD}/model_blend_best.joblib")

open(f"{WARD}/README.txt", "w").write(
    "ROUND 4 - CV-tuned LR+ExtraTrees soft-vote\n"
    f"Chosen (5-fold CV on 712 rows): w={bw}, ET max_depth={bd}, min_samples_leaf={bl}, CV acc={best.cv_acc:.4f} "
    f"(incumbent 0.5/6/4 CV={inc_cv:.4f})\n"
    "Inference: blend prob = w*p_LR + (1-w)*p_ET; Survived = 1 if prob>=0.5 else 0.\n"
    "Fit on all 712 train_data/train.csv rows; validation/test transform-only. Seed 42, CPU only.\n"
    "Deliverables: predictions.csv (418 rows), work/val_predictions.csv (179 rows) from the SAME model.\n")

# ---- assertions ----
vp = pd.read_csv(f"{WARD}/val_predictions.csv")
assert list(vp.columns) == ["PassengerId", "Survived"] and len(vp) == 179
assert vp["PassengerId"].tolist() == val_ids
assert list(pp.columns) == ["PassengerId", "Survived"] and len(pp) == 418
assert pp["PassengerId"].tolist() == test["PassengerId"].tolist()
assert set(vp["Survived"].unique()) <= {0, 1}
assert set(pp["Survived"].unique()) <= {0, 1}

print("\nFINAL: w=%.1f depth=%d leaf=%d | CV=%.4f vs incumbent CV=%.4f (val 0.8492)" % (
    bw, bd, bl, best.cv_acc, inc_cv))
print("val pos rate %.3f | test pos rate %.3f" % (vp["Survived"].mean(), pp["Survived"].mean()))
